When the task exists, preserve the existing successful GET behavior and response.
Do not alter unrelated task routes or behaviors, and do not modify tests.

Adding new API semantics beyond the specified nonexistent-task response.
acceptance: GET /tasks/missing (or any other nonexistent task id) returns status 404.

Existing unrelated route behavior remains unchanged.
The existing test suite passes without test modifications.
